findings.closure: run_command no longer runs on the host. Every command executes inside one bubblewrap capsule (admissible/paired_runner/sandbox.py) shared identically by the future DIRECT and GOVERNED modes: the workspace is bind-mounted at the single internal path /workspace, only an explicit read-only toolchain list is exposed, /tmp and /proc are private, the network namespace is unshared, --clearenv removes every inherited credential and the host HOME, and the durable evidence root is absent from the mount namespace entirely. If bubblewrap or any required isolation is unavailable, readiness raises SandboxUnavailable before any proposal is published; there is no unsandboxed Popen fallback anywhere in the code.
findings.evidence: SandboxEscapeMatrixTests: absolute-path read/write, ../ traversal, /proc discovery, evidence-root access, host HOME, host /tmp, network, detached descendant, double fork, setsid, and evidence corruption are each physically refused or isolated.

findings.closure: WorkspaceBinding.bind now executes nothing at all; it is pure syscalls, so no process-capable observer runs before the proposal is durable. Git observation happens only after publication, runs inside the same capsule, and neutralises every repository-controlled setting on the command line where a repository cannot outrank it: core.fsmonitor, hooks, external diff, textconv, credential/ssh/askpass helpers, alternateRefsCommand, pager, and submodule recursion. GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 and --no-optional-locks mean no index or worktree mutation.
findings.evidence: MaliciousGitConfigurationTests: fsmonitor, hooks, include.path re-entry, external diff and textconv, credential/pager/ssh helpers, and submodules execute nothing; the index and worktree are byte- and mtime-identical after observation; binding a hostile repository runs no process.

findings.closure: Supervision is driven by a private PID namespace whose init (_capsule_init.py, PID 1 via --as-pid-1) reaps every descendant. Pipe EOF is no longer a termination condition: the controller loop ends only when the launcher is reaped, and the launcher exits only after the in-capsule init observes ECHILD. descendants_reaped is therefore a kernel observation, not an assertion, and ProcessObservation validation forbids claiming it independently of the observed quiescence. A surviving descendant or a missing process-domain observation can never yield COMPLETED. Escalation is SIGTERM then SIGKILL across the whole namespace, so setsid and double-fork cannot evade it.
findings.evidence: ProcessDomainQuiescenceTests: a process closing both pipes is supervised for its full requested timeout (previously killed after a fixed 2s); a child holding one pipe, a SIGTERM-ignoring descendant, a zombie, a surviving descendant, a double fork, and setsid are all contained, detected, and reaped; AFTER observations occur only post-quiescence.

findings.closure: One authoritative typed path (admissible/paired_runner/reconciliation.py) loads every referenced object from durable bytes, reconstructs it as its exact typed class, and cross-checks run, proposal, specification, decision, reservation, lifecycle order, observation phase, stream identity, and every ledger field against the object it claims to describe. The exact expected object set is derived from tool, effect class, lifecycle status, and decision, so both omission and surplus fail. The circularity is removed: EffectLedgerEntry is type-constrained to PENDING_VERIFICATION and cannot be constructed claiming success, while a separate FinalReconciliation record binds the exact pending entry and every verified object. RunEffectLedger.verify now verifies the whole chain, not the entry's own bytes. Reconciliation requires the exact specification or an externally supplied exact fingerprint.
findings.evidence: TypedReconciliationTests: deleting or corrupting every persisted referenced object fails closed; a canonical record of the wrong type, a mutated canonical field, a wrong run, a wrong proposal, a foreign specification, and an unexpected extra object are each refused; the ledger entry is durable as PENDING_VERIFICATION; ledger verification fails when a referenced object is deleted.

findings.closure: enforce_evidence_root_isolation runs before proposal publication. Both roots are opened as descriptors and required to be absolute, non-symlink, canonical directories; containment is checked in both directions; (device, inode) identities are compared so a hard link, bind alias, or rename cannot make two names refer to one directory; the store root must not be group- or world-accessible. Identities are recorded and rechecked at preflight and before each effect. The capsule refuses any construction that would expose the evidence root, and store operations remain descriptor-relative.
findings.evidence: EvidenceRootIsolationTests: overlap in both directions, symlink alias, group/world-accessible mode, root replacement after binding, and a capsule asked to expose the evidence root are all refused; the same-UID absolute-path and /proc-discovery attempts are covered by the escape matrix.

findings.closure: prepare_effect resolves every physical precondition and retains the proven descriptors before any STARTED record is published, so a physical refusal is genuinely pre-effect. The four tools then act on the retained descriptors rather than re-resolving a path string. Receipt (REFUSED, effect_started=false), the absent STARTED record, the absent ledger entry, the run index (effect_crossed_boundary=false), and typed reconciliation all agree. Directory creation for create_parents is deliberately excluded from preparation because it is itself a mutation.
findings.evidence: PhysicalRefusalLifecycleTests: absent target, symlinked target, directory target, absent parent, and special files across all four tools each produce a consistent pre-effect refusal with no contradicting STARTED or ledger evidence.

findings.closure: observe_filesystem now stream-hashes the bytes of every regular file and binds relative path, file type, mode, size, content fingerprint, and a symlink's target bytes without following the link. Every entry that cannot be listed, stated, opened, or read is recorded as an explicit error rather than skipped, and FilesystemObservation validation forbids a COMPLETE observation that carries errors or truncation. Entry and byte limits produce explicit incomplete states, and only a COMPLETE, OBSERVED record may serve as a final repository fingerprint.
findings.evidence: FilesystemObservationCompletenessTests: same-size substitution, symlink retarget, and truncation all change the fingerprint; unreadable directories and files are recorded; entry and byte limits are explicit; large and sparse files are hashed; a FIFO is typed but never opened.

findings.closure: read_file opens with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC and decides on the open descriptor with fstat, so only a regular file is ever read. FIFO, socket, device, directory, and any other special inode are refused, and ENXIO from a writer-less FIFO is refused by type rather than waited on. The open cannot block, so a hostile filesystem object cannot hang the controller.
findings.evidence: BoundedSpecialFileTests: a FIFO is refused promptly, a Unix socket and a directory are refused, and a regular file still reads normally.

findings.closure: SharedEffectSubstrate.preflight runs before proposal publication and validates ledger run identity, run-index run identity, specification/proposal run agreement, the workspace/specification binding, executor identity, evidence-root identity and inode, workspace root inode, tool catalogue membership, capsule readiness, and run-index integrity. No configuration or identity error can be discovered after the effect.
findings.evidence: PreflightConfigurationTests: a ledger for another run, a workspace bound to another specification, and a store that is not the bound evidence root each refuse with nothing published, no workspace mutation, and zero effect invocations.

findings.closure: admissible/paired_runner/run_index.py adds an immutable hash-chained run index. Every proposal is indexed including refusals; each entry carries its sequence and its predecessor's fingerprint, binding run, session, turn, and proposal causal order; the chain reconstructs from durable bytes; omission, duplication, reordering, and cross-run substitution are detected; and head_sequence() reads durable bytes so a restart cannot silently begin empty. It is provider-free and single-session: no model, transport, token, cost, or continuation field exists.
findings.evidence: DurableRunIndexTests: refusals are indexed alongside effects, the chain reconstructs without memory, restart sees prior history, and omission, reordering, cross-run substitution, and duplication are each detected.

findings.closure: Six fault points were added: observer failure after STARTED, capsule supervisor death, the gap between the effect returning and the AFTER observations, the pending ledger entry publication, and both phases of the separate final reconciliation publication, bringing the total to 19. Surviving-descendant detection, typed referenced-object corruption, deleted referenced objects, evidence-root access attempts, and a process closing its pipes before exit are all covered. A fault oracle independent of the implementation classification table judges every point.
findings.evidence: tests/test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_fault_oracle.py asserts four properties from durable bytes and the workspace itself, consulting no classification the implementation computes; CrashMatrixTests replays all 19 declared points.

governing_principle: The effect process is untrusted. Proposal and authority evidence are durable before any untrusted effect; the effect can touch only the authorized workspace; it cannot see or alter evidence; every descendant is quiescent before AFTER observations and terminal evidence; and complete reconciliation is derived from the entire typed durable chain rather than asserted by the ledger itself.
known_limitations: The capsule is namespace- and mount-based. No seccomp syscall filter is applied, and no cgroup CPU, memory, or PID limit is imposed beyond the request timeout.
Isolation depends on unprivileged user namespaces being enabled on the host. Where they are not, readiness refuses before any effect rather than degrading.

Filesystem observation streams file bytes, so observation cost is proportional to workspace size; a workspace exceeding the entry or byte limit yields an explicit incomplete observation that cannot serve as a final repository fingerprint.

Publication receipt fingerprints remain recorded in the ledger entry as an accounting of the publication sequence; they are not independently verifiable durable objects, and no reconciliation verdict depends on them.
The run index is single-session and provider-free by construction; multi-session continuation is deliberately absent and is not implied by it.
Resource measurement remains OBSERVED_BEST_EFFORT because getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) aggregates every reaped child of the controller.
No installed-path, production-root, or owner-authority behaviour is exercised or claimed.
next_permitted_action: Independent re-audit of these Milestone 2 critical repairs. Milestone 3 remains not permitted until that audit closes.
